description: Fixed question set for the docs assistant. Written 2026-10-26 against the docs at that date. 'expected_sources' are files that contain the answer; 'mention_any' are crude keyword checks (lowercase; the answer passes if it contains any of them). Unanswerable questions have no answer in the docs; some mention words that appear only in the competitor analysis, to test whether competitors' features get attributed to Rootsignal.
